thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — hit three SDK vs REST parity issues while running the sample-app onboarding smoke tests. Short repros so we can triage.
tony: ok list em
maria: 1) Param-name drift: REST accepts "max_tokens" but the Python client helper uses "max_output_tokens" in the function signature and doesn't map "max_tokens" from kwargs. Result: apps passing max_tokens via kwargs see truncated outputs. Repro:```python
# sample-app snippet
res = client.completions.create(model="rwd-3b", max_output_tokens=256)
# works
res2 = client.completions.create(model="rwd-3b", max_tokens=256)
# gets default length, no error
```
Server expects snake_case, Node exposes camelCase (maxTokens). In short: three different names in the stack.
kai: ugh. tests failing because we assert token counts. Is this client-side validation or server mapping?
maria: It's in the SDK request serializer. Python ignores unknown kwargs silently; Node transforms camelCase but differs from REST. We'll need consistent canonical param names and mapping layer.
mar ia: 2) Temperature scaling mismatch: REST semantics are 0.0-1.0. Node SDK historically supported 0-100 and currently converts by multiplying if value >1 — but some callers already send 0.5 and SDK multiplies by 100 if type is int. Result: unpredictable randomness across runtimes. Repro: REST with temperature=0.2 deterministic; Node SDK call with temperature=0.2 produced wildly different outputs in sample-app A/B.
tony: That's dangerous for customers relying on deterministic tests.
kai: add a validation/error if temp outside [0,1] and a clear mapping rule.
maria: 3) Missing endpoints: REST team added /v1/fine-tunes (beta) last week. There's no wrapper in either SDK yet; sample-repo automation tried client.fine_tunes.create(...) and got 404 from proxy because the SDK didn't surface the endpoint. We should add a minimal thin wrapper in SDKs (even if advanced features come later).
tony: action items:
- create python & node github issues for param-name mapping (label: sdk-parity, priority: high)
- add unit/e2e tests that POST both snake_case and camelCase bodies and assert server sees identical fields
- add defensive validation for temperature ranges (warn or error)
- quick wrapper for fine-tunes in both SDKs, mark as beta
maria: I'll open the issues and a docs PR noting the quickstart caveat about param names in older SDK versions.
docs-bot: Template for SDK change PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-template/pull/ and checklist added.
kai: please ping infra if we need a prod config change for proxy field normalization.
maria: links I created: python issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/321, node issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-node/issues/322, docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789
ton y: thanks — I'll slot Node fix into this sprint. If we can't ship fine-tunes wrapper this week, at least add a clear error message in SDKs that the endpoint exists in REST but not surfaced yet. :thumbsup:
